title: Second-order oscillator propagator as a trigonometric block of exp(t companion); omega=0 confluence
expression_sketch:
Scalar oscillator y'' + omega**2 * y = 0, omega in C. Companion form
  z' = C * z,  z=[y, y'],  C = [[0, 1], [-omega**2, 0]].
Primary matrix exponential (Higham, Functions of Matrices, Ch. 12; Hairer-Lubich-Wanner GNI, oscillatory flows):
  exp(t*C) = [[ cos(omega*t),  sin(omega*t)/omega ],
              [ -omega*sin(omega*t), cos(omega*t) ]]   for omega != 0,
with entire continuation at omega=0:
  exp(t*[[0,1],[0,0]]) = [[1, t], [0, 1]].
Equivalently sin(omega*t)/omega -> t, the sinc continuation. Cos/sin addition (propagator composition):
  cos((t+s)*omega) = cos(t*omega)*cos(s*omega) - sin(t*omega)*sin(s*omega).
Euler member (entire in a square matrix M):
  exp(I*M) = cos(M) + I*sin(M),
  cos(M)=(exp(I*M)+exp(-I*M))/2,  sin(M)=(exp(I*M)-exp(-I*M))/(2*I).
SymPy residual: (sin(w*t)/w)*w - sin(w*t) == 0 off 0; limit w->0 of sin(w*t)/w - t == 0; det(exp(t*C))=1=exp(t*tr(C)).
latent_structure: Master object: the exponential of the 2x2 companion (or equivalently the pair of entire functions cos, sinc of omega*t). The omega != 0 trigonometric block and the omega=0 Galilean block [[1,t],[0,1]] are one entire matrix function of omega. Cos/sin of a general matrix are the real/imaginary parts of exp(I M). Reconstruction uses VALUE of that exponential, plus piecewise unification of the sinc quotient with the value t.

function_domains.sin: entire as a primary matrix function

nonzero_conditions.statement: The writing sin(omega*t)/omega is for omega != 0; the value at omega=0 is the separate member t (times y'(0))
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED

real_valued_functions: cos, sin on the real line when omega and t are real

analytic_domains.label: DECLARED

analytic_domains.statement: The map omega |-> sin(omega*t)/omega extends to an entire function of omega (value t at 0)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Entire continuation of sinc; elementary Taylor series of sin

analytic_domains.statement: exp(I*M)=cos(M)+I*sin(M) is an identity of entire matrix functions
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED

branch_conventions: Primary matrix cos/sin; not entrywise trigonometric functions.
I is the imaginary unit with I**2=-1.
sin(omega*t)/omega denotes the entire continuation, not a principal-value cut on omega.

limit_domains.statement: omega -> 0 is an unrestricted complex limit; sin(omega*t)/omega -> t
limit_domains.label: DECLARED
limit_domains.source: Taylor series of sin; Higham Ch. 12 entire functions

derived_conditions.statement: Entire continuation unifies the omega != 0 trigonometric block with exp(t*[[0,1],[0,0]])=[[1,t],[0,1]]
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: Power series of exp(t C) at omega=0; sinc continuation

derived_conditions.statement: det(exp(t C))=exp(t tr(C))=1, matching cos**2+(sin**2)=1 in the omega != 0 writing
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

derived_conditions.statement: The block multiplication exp((t+s)C)=exp(t C) exp(s C) is the cos/sin addition formula
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

public_source: Higham, Functions of Matrices, SIAM 2008, Chapter 12 (matrix cosine and sine; exp(iA)=cos(A)+i sin(A)); Hairer, Lubich and Wanner, Geometric Numerical Integration, 2ed, Chapter XIII; elementary closed form of y''+omega^2 y=0; Gautschi, Numer. Math. 3 (1961) 381-397.
why_not_cse_lgg: CSE may rewrite sin(w t)/w at the symbol level but will not identify the 2x2 trigonometric block, the omega=0 Galilean block, the addition formula, and exp(I M)=cos(M)+I sin(M) as one companion exponential. LGG has no oscillator-propagator constructor. Distinct from Hochbruck phi_k = exp[0^{(k)}, z] (that is a first-order exponential-integrator family, not cos/sinc of a square root frequency).
proposer_leak_risk: Hide: Rodrigues, phi-function, exponential integrator, Hochbruck, Gautschi, companion matrix, symplectic, sinc. Show unlabeled members: the 2x2 trig block, the [[1,t],[0,1]] block, sin(w*t)/w, t, and cos((t+s)*w) vs the addition expansion.
notes: SciML role: exact flow of linear Hamiltonian / oscillatory second-order systems; trigonometric integrators. Catalog: G0001=sin(w*t)/w; G0002=t; G0003=cos(w*t); G0004=[[1,t],[0,1]]; G0005=exp(t*[[0,1],[-w**2,0]]). Operators: VALUE of exp(t C), piecewise unification at omega=0. NOT sciml-phi-hermite-01. NOT sciml-vanloan-blockexp-01. NOT sciml-ou-mehler-01 (that is a stochastic Mehler kernel).
